panels.title: Active people
panels.description: Different people who did anything in the time range.

targets.expr: count by (deployment_environment_name) (sum by (deployment_environment_name, user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"keepup[.].*" | user_id!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Visits (browser sessions)
panels.description: Browser sessions started (Faro).

targets.expr: sum by (deployment_environment_name) (count_over_time({service_name="Keepup", kind="event", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} |= "event_name=session_start" | logfmt | event_name="session_start" [$__range]))

panels.title: Sign-ins
panels.description: keepup.signed_in.

panels.title: Sign-ups
panels.description: New accounts (a password sign-up counts when its email is confirmed).

panels.title: Demo visits
panels.description: Try the demo.

panels.title: Check-ins
panels.description: Saved check-ins.

panels.title: Who: activity per person
panels.description: Product actions per person in the range (a demo login has no email and isn't listed).

targets.expr: sum by (user_email, deployment_environment_name) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"keepup[.].*" | event_name!="keepup.error" | user_email!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: How people sign in
panels.description: Google or password.

panels.title: Check-ins per active person
panels.description: Saved check-ins ÷ active people, in the range.

targets.expr: sum by (deployment_environment_name) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="keepup.check_in" | check_in_outcome="saved" [$__range])) / count by (deployment_environment_name) (sum by (deployment_environment_name, user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"keepup[.].*" | user_id!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Undo rate
panels.description: Undone ÷ saved check-ins: mis-taps or a confusing button.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (deployment_environment_name) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="keepup.check_in_undone" [$__range])) / sum by (deployment_environment_name) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="keepup.check_in" | check_in_outcome="saved" [$__range]))

panels.title: Cheers and nudges per active person
panels.description: How much the 'together' part is used.

targets.expr: sum by (deployment_environment_name) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"keepup.(cheer_sent|nudge_sent)" [$__range])) / count by (deployment_environment_name) (sum by (deployment_environment_name, user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"keepup[.].*" | user_id!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: People with reminders on
panels.description: Active people who turned push on in the range (a turn-on before the range isn't counted).

targets.expr: 100 * count by (deployment_environment_name) (sum by (deployment_environment_name, user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="keepup.push_enabled" [$__range]))) / count by (deployment_environment_name) (sum by (deployment_environment_name, user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"keepup[.].*" | user_id!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Active people, rolling 24 hours
panels.description: Each point: different people active in the 24 hours before it, updated hourly. (One bar per calendar day would show today only after midnight UTC.)

targets.expr: count by (deployment_environment_name) (sum by (deployment_environment_name, user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"keepup[.].*" | user_id!="" [1d])))

panels.title: New-user funnel (people per step, in the range)
panels.description: Different people reaching each step. Not a strict cohort: someone who signed up before the range can still show in later steps.

targets.expr: count(sum by (user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="keepup.check_in" | check_in_outcome="saved" | user_id!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Check-ins: own habits vs for a child
panels.description: For a child: tapped by an adult or by the child.

panels.title: Habits created: private vs group
panels.description: habit.scope.

panels.title: Browser errors people hit, by screen
panels.description: JS errors in the browser (Faro exceptions).

panels.title: Browsers
panels.description: Per visit.

targets.expr: sum by (browser_name) (count_over_time({service_name="Keepup", kind="event", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} |= "event_name=session_start" | logfmt | event_name="session_start" [$__range]))

panels.title: Operating systems
panels.description: Per visit.

targets.expr: sum by (os_name) (count_over_time({service_name="Keepup", kind="event", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} |= "event_name=session_start" | logfmt | event_name="session_start" [$__range]))

panels.title: Phone or computer
panels.description: browser_mobile: true = phone or tablet.

targets.expr: sum by (browser_mobile) (count_over_time({service_name="Keepup", kind="event", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} |= "event_name=session_start" | logfmt | event_name="session_start" [$__range]))

panels.title: Who uses what
panels.description: Screens viewed per person and device.

targets.expr: sum by (user_email, browser_name, os_name, browser_mobile) (count_over_time({service_name="Keepup", kind="event", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} |= "event_name=view_changed" | logfmt | event_name="view_changed" | user_email!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Most viewed screens
panels.description: Screen changes, by route (ids folded to [id]).

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (event_data_toView) (count_over_time({service_name="Keepup", kind="event", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} |= "event_name=view_changed" | logfmt | event_name="view_changed" [$__range])))

panels.title: Screen views per hour
panels.description: When the app is used.

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_toView) (count_over_time({service_name="Keepup", kind="event", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} |= "event_name=view_changed" | logfmt | event_name="view_changed" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Top checked-in habits
panels.description: Saved check-ins per habit.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (habit_title) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="keepup.check_in" | check_in_outcome="saved" [$__range])))

panels.title: Habits created, by category
panels.description: New habits.

panels.title: Check-ins per hour
panels.description: When people check in.

panels.title: Habit lifecycle
panels.description: Created, edited, archived, restored, deleted, finished, restarted, undone.

panels.title: Feature use
panels.description: How often each feature is used.

panels.title: Refused by a rule (friction)
panels.description: WARN events and refused check-ins, by rule: where people get stuck.

targets.expr: sum by (event_name, refusal_code, check_in_reason) (count_over_time({service_name="keepup", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | refusal_code!="" or check_in_outcome="refused" [$__range]))

panels.title: Latest actions
panels.description: Every product event, newest first.
